air-back.draw: pillars on the far half of the band: draw AFTER ground, BEFORE bodies

air-front.draw: near-half pillars + dust: draw over bodies

anchor_rule: both layers anchor on HELVAR's foot at cast (line origin). Line runs 9 tiles along the cast vector.

windup.runs: from cast start until 60 ms before the hit (440 ms), looping

impact.note: f1 = 60 ms hold-off that starts 60 ms before the hit; f2 = biggest frame, the sim hit/CC lands at its first ms. Renderer may add a 100 ms freeze on f2 for R casts.

linger_ground.note: ground keeps going after the air strip ends; total ground linger 700 ms

directions.rule: pick the facing nearest the cast vector (8-way). For w/sw/nw use the e/se/ne strips flipped horizontally AND mirror the anchor x: anchor_x' = cell_w - anchor_x. n and s are authored because the air elements stand upright (a vertical flip would put them upside down).

draw_order_split: RECOMMENDED: ground -> air-back -> bodies (y-sorted) -> air-front. The crest pillars on the far half of the band then stand BEHIND the units they pass, so knocked-back units are never hidden. Fallback: ground -> bodies -> air (full) hides a unit for ~1 frame as the crest passes it.
knockback: no status plate (displacement only): renderer moves hit units 2.2 tiles along the line during impact f2-f5; the rubble trail is the dash/wave trail
